intro: Journey into Thunder Bluff is the culminating pilgrimage marking the end of a young hero's trials across Mulgore. Having completed the sacred Rites of the Earthmother under the guidance of the spirits, the adventurer is granted an audience with the High Chieftain of the tauren, Cairne Bloodhoof.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You will now be revered within our great city. Any traveler worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.
For your final quest, seek out our noble leader, Cairne Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hail, young adventurer. I see you found your way to my doorstep.
